sloka: गता भगवती रात्रिः श्रोतव्यम् परमम् श्रुतम् ।तराम सरितम् श्रेष्टम् पुण्यम् त्रि पथ गाम् नदीम् ॥१-४५-६॥
transliteration: gatā bhagavatī rātriḥ śrotavyam paramam śrutam ।tarāma saritam śreṣṭam puṇyam tri patha gām nadīm ॥1-45-6॥

translations.english: We will cross over Ganga, the best of rivers, the sacred river that flows in three directions.This boat of pious saints which is well laidout has come here swiftly, having come to know that you, O Venerable one have arrived".
